SECTION_RADIO_DESC: Configure the 5 quick-access radio presets displayed on the CoreZoneDisplay Radio screen.
ENABLE_SCREENSAVER_DOC: Automatically display the clock screensaver overlay when the screen is idle.
IDLE_TIMEOUT_DOC: Seconds of inactivity before the clock screensaver overlay activates.
ACTIVE_CLOCK_DOC: Choose which clock HTML file from submodule/clocks to display in the screensaver.
RADIO_NAME_DOC: Display name shown on the touchscreen preset button.
